rate_limit_per_hour.description: Maximum number of API requests per hour. Defaults to 3000.

rate_limit_per_second.description: Maximum number of API requests per second. Defaults to 20.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for API requests. Defaults to 120 seconds.

token.description: Name.com API Token Value; can alternatively be specified via the `NAMEDOTCOM_TOKEN` environment variable.

username.description: Name.com API Username; can alternatively be specified via the `NAMEDOTCOM_USERNAME` environment variable.

algorithm.description: Algorithm is an integer identifying the algorithm used for signing. Changing this forces a new resource.

digest.description: Digest is a digest of the DNSKEY RR that is registered with the registry. Changing this forces a new resource.

digest_type.description: DigestType is an integer identifying the algorithm used to create the digest. Changing this forces a new resource.

domain_name.description: DomainName is the zone that the DNSSEC belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.

id.description: Resource identifier, equal to the domain name.

key_tag.description: KeyTag contains the key tag value of the DNSKEY RR that validates this signature. Changing this forces a new resource.

domain_name.description: DomainName is the punycode encoded value of the domain name. Changing this forces a new resource.

id.description: Resource identifier, equal to the domain name.

nameservers.description: Nameservers is the set of nameservers for this domain. Order is not significant; the registry treats nameservers as a set. If unspecified it defaults to your account default nameservers.

answer.description: Answer is the record value: the IP address for A and AAAA records, the target for ANAME, CNAME, MX, NS, and SRV records, or the text for TXT records.

domain_name.description: DomainName is the zone that the record belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.

host.description: Host is the hostname relative to the zone.

id.description: Unique record id assigned by Name.com.

record_id.description: Unique record id assigned by Name.com (numeric form of `id`).

record_type.description: Type is one of the following: A, AAAA, ANAME, CNAME, MX, NS, SRV, or TXT. Changing this forces a new resource.
